title: RBAC v2: audit-proxy + gradual admin-elevation orchestration
creator: Amaya Chen
description: Build a lightweight audit-proxy and operator safelist to enable a phased RBAC v1->v2 migration with minimal disruption. The audit-proxy will surface dual-write discrepancies, enrich audit logs with mapping context (SSO/SAML nameid, org mapping), and gate admin elevation by operator safelist and a time-limited grace policy. Goal: allow canary customers and internal orgs to opt into v2 early while preserving a fast rollback path.
acceptance_criteria: Audit-proxy running in staging and production that ingests auth events and emits enriched events to the audit log (schema versioned)
Dual-write discrepancy dashboard shows <1% divergence on canary orgs after 24h of steady traffic
Operator safelist service honors TTL-based elevation with audit trail for every grant/revocation
Cutover playbook updated with step-by-step commands and verification SQL queries
Customer opt-in flow and email template reviewed by legal and comms
Security review completed and sign-off recorded in JIRA/Confluence
implementation_plan: Phase 0: Prototype audit-proxy that subscribes to auth events (kafka://redwood-auth) and writes enriched records to audit-log-v2 topic
Phase 1: Deploy audit-proxy in staging, run dual-write shadow for role writes for 48h against sample orgs
Phase 2: Enable operator safelist service with UI toggle in internal console; implement TTL + manual revoke endpoint
Phase 3: Start canary cohort (5 orgs) with admin-elevation enabled; collect metrics for 72h
Phase 4: Expand to 25 orgs by waves; run backfill job to reconcile role assignments where dual-write failed
Phase 5: Cutover checklist execution and final switch for waves that meet SLOs
backfill_steps: Identify missing assignments: SELECT org_id, user_id FROM role_store_v1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM role_store_v2 WHERE ...)
Create curated backfill payloads grouped by org and size; surface large-org backfills for manual review
Run backfill in dry-run mode and validate against audit-proxy diffs
Throttle writes with per-org rate limiter during backfill to avoid DB hotspots
Mark reconciled records with reconciliation_tag and push to audit-log-v2
dual_write_strategy: Implement dual-write shim at service layer for write operations; write to v1 and v2 with correlation_id
Use idempotency keys and sequencing to make writes retry-safe
Emit comparison events to audit-proxy with pre/post snapshots
Backpressure path: if v2 write latency > 500ms, route to fallback queue and alert SRE
Periodic async reconcilers run full-table diffs for low-traffic orgs
audit_and_observability: Enriched audit schema: {timestamp, actor, org_id, action, v1_snapshot, v2_snapshot, sso_nameid, correlation_id}
Dashboard: dual-write divergence rate, reconciliation backlog, avg v2 write latency
SLOs: dual-write divergence <= 0.5% for canary wave, v2 write p95 < 200ms
Logging: redaction rules applied for PII; KMS-integrated envelope encryption for audit exports
Alerting: divergence > 2% for 1h triggers PagerDuty escalation
sso_saml_considerations: Normalize SAML NameID formats during migration and persist original_nameid in audit-proxy
Map legacy role assertions to v2 schema via translation table; log unmapped assertions for manual triage
Add a reconciliation step that cross-checks SSO assertion timestamps with role create timestamps to detect replay issues
Coordinate with IdP teams for propagation delays during cutover windows
admin_controls_and_grace_policy: Operator safelist permits temporary elevation for specified actor:grant until TTL expiry
Default grace window for existing admins: 14 days after opt-in to allow manual mapping adjustments
Audit trail required for every elevation, reason codes standardized
Self-service revoke available to org admins; system-initiated revoke when dual-write divergence > 5%
rollback_plan: Step 1: Disable new admin-elevation endpoints and operator safelist toggles
Step 2: Stop v2 writes by flipping dual-write shim to v1-only (feature flag) and reroute in-flight requests
Step 3: Run targeted reconciliation to restore v1 authoritative state where partial v2 writes occurred
Step 4: Communicate rollback to affected customers with root-cause and ETA for next attempt
Step 5: Postmortem and action items recorded in Confluence and shared with stakeholders
comms_and_customer_ops: Customer opt-in doc: Confluence link placeholder and checklist for org admins
Email template v1: subject 'Redwood: RBAC migration opt-in and admin grace window'
Customer dashboard: per-org migration status with ability to opt-out within grace period
Support playbook: KB article for common failure modes and escalations to SRE/security
Scheduled office hours during canary waves for hands-on help
